title: CHESS: CHEbyshev pSeudo-Spectral transport for Feynman integral differential equations
summary: We present CHESS (CHEbyshev pSeudo Spectrum), a Wolfram Language package for high-precision one-dimensional transport of ε-factorized differential equations for Feynman master integrals. The solver works with the matrix obtained by pulling a differential one-form to a chosen path. This matrix may be supplied directly, or assembled from constant matrices and precomputed scalar pullbacks of the one-forms.
